text:
maria: bringing up rwd-v3-small-int4-hybrid on staging + shadow for 24h. planning gated rollout 0.5% -> 3% -> 10%. want to lock down canary gates and the auto-fallback semantics before we flip production. key signals: MRR_rerank, answer_fidelity (annotated), hallucination_rate, latency_p95, cost_delta.

sam: short checklist: keep short holds at the tiny slices because we see noisy spikes. my suggested holds: 45m @0.5%, 90m @3%, 4h @10%. require min_requests: 2500,5000,20000 respectively.

jon: add per-slice z-tests with Bonferroni for the 10% stage (longform, code, faq). for the small stages use bayesian sequential with alpha~0.01 equiv. auto-fallback triggers:
- MRR_rel_drop >= 1.2% OR absolute drop >= 1pp
- answer_fidelity drop by >= 1.0pp (annotated)
- hallucination_rate increase >= 2.0pp (manual spot)
- latency_p95 rel increase >= 20%
- cost_delta <= -15% (not a trigger, just log)

lisa: ops note: make sure rollout policy includes immediate-rollback flag (no staged cooldown) if any slice reports p<0.005 in sequential test. also enable quiet-burn shadow for 50k samples overnight.

canary-bot: smoke-run summary (shadow 2k samples):
- MRR_rerank baseline 0.398 -> candidate 0.392 (-1.51%)
- answer_fidelity (annotated sample 300): baseline 91.2% -> candidate 90.1% (-1.2pp)
- hallucination sample 200: baseline 1.8% -> candidate 2.6% (+0.8pp)
- latency_p95 baseline 145ms -> candidate 165ms (+13.8%)
- cost per tok: -22% (candidate cheaper)
note: small N for fidelity/hallu samples, variance high.

maria: thanks. given MRR drop ~1.5% on shadow, that's above our soft threshold. i'm going to run an expanded shadow (10k) specifically weighted to longform and code slices before any live percent. also tagging for manual annotation on 1k longform outputs. holding live rollout until those come back.

sam: agree. if expanded shadow confirms >1% MRR drop on longform, we should abort promote and open a tuning ticket (quant params / kv-warmup). could also try hybrid-int8 fallback for longform only.

jon: i'll set up the sequential testing windows and dashboards. baseline window = last 14 days; apply stratified bootstrap for CIs by slice. will alert channel on p<0.01.

maria: plan updated: step A = 10k stratified shadow (longform/code/short) + 1k manual annotations in longform. step B = if MRR_rel_drop <= 1.0% and fidelity loss <=0.8pp we proceed to 0.5% live with 45m hold and auto-rollback rules as discussed. otherwise abort and triage. will post the expanded-shadow results here.

(canary-bot): started expanded shadow @1758881250

(ends)
